correctness.rationale: Exact orthogonal decomposition into edgewise Dirichlet modes and the one-dimensional endpoint-antisymmetric mode gives both evaluation diagonals. The strict positivity beta_i=((T-L_i)(c-1/L_i)-1)/(T(1+L_i(c-1/L_i))) for r>=3 follows from Cauchy–Schwarz; beta_i=0 for r=2. The identity (Li-Lj)(T-Li-Lj) fully classifies global norming points. Hilbert reproducing kernels show sharpness and every equality case. The separately executed exact rational graph-Poisson stiffness solver independently checked 230 finite instances across seven arbitrary rational length families. No finite check is used as the universal proof.

value.rationale: The invariant compares the sharp mean-zero Sobolev norm before and after a natural topological quotient that changes the cycle rank and, as Cinkir shows, changes the tau constant. A complete exact pointwise correction, cancellation at norming midpoints, preservation of extremizing Green kernels, arbitrary-edge-length rigidity and the sharp two-edge exception explain a non-obvious structural stability phenomenon. Its precise invariant and topology comparison are motivated independently of a numerical table.
